notes.title: ZAMB! Endless Extermination is now available!
notes.content:
It's on! You can buy ZAMB! Endless Extermination on Steam now!

In this year, Nano Games celebrates its 10th anniversary! On this occasion, we decided to publish ZAMB! Endless Extermination with a special regular price 2.99 USD, 2.39 EUR, 2.09 GBP, 10.99 PLN (and more currencies :) )!!!

Have ZAMBastic fun!!!

notes.title: ZAMB! Endless Extermination Closed Beta starts today!
notes.content: Today is the first day of our Closed Beta! We begin at RTX London 2018 - visitors who come to our booth and take part in the ZAMB! Tournament will be invited to the beta. We're looking forward to your feedback!
